newsitem.title: USA: Technology stocks fall on lower earnings outlooks.
newsitem.headline: Technology stocks fall on lower earnings outlooks.

text.p: Several technology stocks fell Thursday after Hutchinson Technology Inc and Zilog Inc projected dismal earnings for the current quarter.

"Hutchinson Tech's commentary is what got the ball rolling in the sector," said Oppenheimer & Co analyst James Poyner. "You had Zilog blowing up last night and that didn't help set the tone." Hutchinson, which makes suspension assemblies for computer disk drives, said late on Wednesday the company is now in its fourth quarter and operating at break-even compared with earnings of $1.55 a share in the year-ago quarter.
Hutchinson Technology shares dropped nearly 13 percent on the news to 34, off 5-1/64 from Wednesday's close.
Zilog, a producer of modem chips among other things, said its third quarter earnings would be lower than second quarter. Zilog shares lost 8-3/8 to 15-1/2.

Direct marketer of computers and computer equipment Gateway 2000 Inc was hit especially hard by the disappointing outlooks, Poyner said, as investors took profits following a recent rise in the stock. Gateway shares fell nearly 10 percent to 40-5/8, a drop of 4-7/16.
Also in the group, CDW Computer Centers Inc fell 4-3/8 to 59-5/8 and Microchip Technology Inc lost 5-1/4 to 31-1/8. -- Chicago newsdesk, 312-408-8787
